resources.string: Paste an inquiry ID and a session token that your server created (POST /api/v1/inquiries/:id/resume), then start the flow. This app contains no credentials.
Or paste a one-time link that your server generated (POST /api/v1/inquiries/:id/generate-one-time-link). It works once; the API base URL above is used.
10.0.2.2 is your computer, as the emulator sees it. Use https for anything else.
Flow completed. Inquiry %1$s is %2$s. Confirm the outcome on your server.
A test harness for sandbox inquiries, not a product.
Sent with a sandbox inquiry\'s signals only. A production server ignores it.
Optional modules in this build: none (the SDK only).
Optional modules in this build: the NFC module, with its chip reader.
Optional modules in this build: the face module, with its face detector.
Optional modules in this build: the NFC module, with its chip reader, and the face module, with its face detector.
The link was refused: it is not a one-time link for this app\'s verification domain.
